newsitem.title: FRANCE: Publicis sees profit growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Publicis sees profit growth in 1997.

text.p: Advertising group Publicis said on Wednesday that it was confident it would report "a good rise" in sales and profits in 1997.
"After the conclusion on February 19, 1997, of an accord with True North, Publicis has room to manoeuvre that will allow it to pursue its global development," it said in a statement.
The accord ended a dispute between the two groups. Publicis, which has activities in more than 40 countries, said it planned to expand in high-growth regions such as Asia and Latin America.

It said in the statement that net attributable profit in 1996 grew to 185 million francs ($32.1 million) from 152.7 million in 1995. Profit of 14 million francs generated by new units in Brazil, Canada, Mexico, Singapore and the Philippines will be consolidated in 1997 accounts, it said.
